# [4.0.0](https://github.com/tombolaltd/game-studio/compare/@game-studio/settings@3.0.0...@game-studio/settings@4.0.0) (2024-09-10)


### Bug Fixes

* **settinga:** fixed typo in component name ([0f80a74](https://github.com/tombolaltd/game-studio/commit/0f80a74fe703a043c66d86f361f787fd540a0bad))


### Features

* **bingo-base:** added no chat option to real time bingo componene, bug fixes ([98fa8ff](https://github.com/tombolaltd/game-studio/commit/98fa8ffa7cd8458162e3b13e41f1ac419d0c39e1))
* **bingo-base:** updated action menu to new designs, major tiy up ([12322ff](https://github.com/tombolaltd/game-studio/commit/12322ffba9eb580ba012885e979b8d6aecfe3754))
* **settings:** updated settigns to use new designs ([269758b](https://github.com/tombolaltd/game-studio/commit/269758bb27799963280b46134dd0089dde57be9f))


### BREAKING CHANGES

* **bingo-base:** action-menu package deleted, its moved directly into bingo base and exposed. it
will never be needed in arcade games. Some prop changes for action menu tand real-time-bingo-game
components
* **settings:** A few. SettingsPLugin now needs a "themeColour" option (this is to theme the
settings). BingoBase options now need "gameLogoBase64" and "gameSplashBackgroundColour". the root
settings menu component now needs a :build-version="" prop.
